findings.title: Fall protection any() stamps whole crew COMPLIANT when only one worker has a harness
findings.description: check_work_activity() sets fall-protection COMPLIANT via any(harness in worker.ppe or guardrail in equipment). One harnessed worker (or a single guardrail token) clears the OSHA-1926.501 CRITICAL check for every co-worker on the activity. Distinct from already-reported height_ft<6 skip and from forging harness strings on every worker / SiteInspectionSystem compliant:true responses.
findings.impact: Official OSHA fall-protection gate authorizes unprotected workers at height. Local PoC: 80 ft steel erection, 5 workers, 1 harness → COMPLIANT; all() correctly False.
findings.attack_path:
1. AI agent uses SafetyComplianceEngine.check_work_activity as the live fall-protection gate.
2. Activity is submitted at height>=6 with multiple workers; only one worker.ppe contains 'harness' (or equipment lists 'guardrail').
3. any() returns True; status=COMPLIANT for the whole activity; no per-worker fall findings.
4. Dashboard publishes COMPLIANT while co-workers remain unprotected — fall fatality exposure.
findings.remediation: Require all() workers to have harness when no collective guardrail/net system is verified. Treat guardrail as collective only when independently confirmed. Emit per-worker NON_COMPLIANT findings.
findings.poc_video_notes: Local non-destructive PoC: 80ft, 5 workers, 1 harness → COMPLIANT; all()=False.

findings.title: Excavation, scaffolding, and electrical OSHA rules are loaded but never evaluated
findings.description: _load_default_rules() registers OSHA-1926.651 (excavation daily inspection, HIGH), OSHA-1926.451 (scaffold ties max_height_without_tie=26, HIGH), and OSHA-1926.405 (GFCI/grounding, CRITICAL). check_work_activity() never references those rule_ids or categories — it only runs fall (height>=6), helmet PPE, hot-work string types, and confined_space flag. An excavation or electrical activity with only a hard hat returns PPE COMPLIANT and nothing else. Distinct from SiteInspectionSystem forged compliant responses and from fall any()/height skip.
findings.impact: Cave-in, scaffold collapse, and electrocution controls advertised in the rule pack never gate work. Local PoC: type=excavation → only PPE COMPLIANT; 651/451/405 never consulted.
findings.attack_path:
1. Agent runs SafetyComplianceEngine as the OSHA activity gate.
2. Attacker (or honest feed) submits excavation/scaffolding/electrical work without shoring, ties, or GFCI.
3. check_work_activity never loads OSHA-1926.651/451/405 into ComplianceCheck results.
4. Only helmet PPE may show COMPLIANT; work proceeds without the advertised life-safety rules.
findings.remediation: Implement excavation (protective system + daily inspection), scaffolding (ties above 26 ft, fully planked), and electrical (GFCI) branches in check_work_activity. Fail closed when activity type matches and required evidence is absent.
findings.poc_video_notes: Local PoC: excavation checks=[PPE COMPLIANT]; scaffolding 40ft with 1 harness → FALL COMPLIANT and 451 never run.

findings.title: Strain/tilt/pressure get empty default thresholds and min never creates low-side alerts
findings.description: register_sensor() copies DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS.get(sensor_type, {}). PRESSURE, STRAIN, TILT (and GPS/PROXIMITY) have no defaults, so thresholds={}. _check_thresholds only alerts when value >= warning/critical — it never alerts on value <= min or a low critical. min/max are used only in _validate_reading to mark SUSPECT. Distinct from the already-reported SUSPECT-spike path that suppresses high-side criticals: here structural movement sensors never alert even on GOOD readings, and any configured safety floor cannot produce CRITICAL.
findings.impact: Structural health / confined-atmosphere floors that agents register as strain, tilt, or pressure (or O2 via min) produce zero alerts. Building movement and oxygen deficiency stay silent on the official IoT aggregator.
findings.attack_path:
1. Agent uses SensorDataAggregator for structural tilt/strain or atmospheric monitoring.
2. Sensor registered as STRAIN/TILT/PRESSURE without custom thresholds (defaults {}), or GAS/TEMP with only min as the safety floor.
3. Extreme reading: empty thresholds → _check_thresholds no-ops; or value < min → SUSPECT and still no low-side alert branch.
4. get_active_alerts / zone summary stay clean while structure moves or atmosphere is unsafe.
findings.remediation: Ship defaults for strain/tilt/pressure. Alert on value <= min and on low critical bands. Never use quality SUSPECT to skip safety alerts. Fail closed when life-safety sensor types have empty thresholds.
findings.poc_video_notes: Local PoC: strain/tilt/pressure defaults {}; O2-like 12 with min→SUSPECT alerts=[]; high-side-only >= cannot express low IDLH.

findings.title: CRITICAL coolant overheat fault never changes OPERATING status — no lockout
findings.description: ingest_reading() derives OperatingStatus solely from engine_rpm/load_percentage. _check_diagnostics can append FaultSeverity.CRITICAL for coolant_temp>100, but get_current_status and get_fleet_summary still report status=operating with active_faults counted separately. There is no lockout, no status=FAULT, and no refuse-to-dispatch path. Distinct from already-reported inverted geofence and from Toolkit equipment-fleet-manager MAINTENANCE assign.
findings.impact: Overheating crane/excavator remains OPERATING on the telematics dashboard used for dispatch. Continued operation risks hydraulic/engine failure and struck-by during failure.
findings.attack_path:
1. Agent uses EquipmentTelematicsManager as live fleet status for dispatch.
2. Honest or spoofed reading: rpm=1800, coolant_temp=110.
3. CRITICAL COOLANT_TEMP_HIGH fault logged; operating_status stays OPERATING.
4. get_current_status/get_fleet_summary show operating equipment; crews keep running the machine.
findings.remediation: On FaultSeverity.CRITICAL set operating status to FAULT/LOCKOUT and exclude from dispatch/fleet operating counts until an authenticated clear.
findings.poc_video_notes: Local PoC: rpm=1800 coolant=110 → status=OPERATING with CRITICAL_fault=True.

findings.title: Storage condition checks skip when material type substring is absent from the name
findings.description: _check_storage_conditions() only applies concrete/steel/wood/paint limits when that keyword appears in material.name.lower(). Typical catalogs (W14x90 Beams, A992 Structural Members, Ready-Mix C40, Lumber SPF) match no key, so the loop continues and temperature/humidity excursions never alert. Distinct from already-reported unauthenticated MQTT spoofing.
findings.impact: Steel corrosion and concrete curing failures proceed without IoT storage alerts when materials use trade names without the generic keyword. Damaged structural materials can be issued to the field.
findings.attack_path:
1. Agent uses MaterialTracker IoT storage monitoring for yard conditions.
2. Materials registered under trade names without 'steel'/'concrete'/'wood'/'paint' substrings.
3. Extreme humidity/temperature readings update StorageCondition but material_type stays None → continue.
4. No alerts; inventory remains is_acceptable; damaged stock ships to install.
findings.remediation: Bind material_type at register_material() (required enum), not substring of name. Fail closed when type is unknown for climate-sensitive categories.
findings.poc_video_notes: Local PoC: W14x90/A992/Ready-Mix C40/Lumber SPF → type=None, all storage checks skipped.

findings.title: check_permit_status is_valid ignores missing documents and null expiry
findings.description: is_valid is True whenever status is ACTIVE/ISSUED and (expiry_date is None or not past). Missing required_documents only append alerts; they never clear is_valid. expiry_date=None is treated as never-expiring. Distinct from already-reported update_status() forge to ISSUED/APPROVED (status escalation). This is the validity gate consumers use after a permit is already ACTIVE.
findings.impact: Work-authorization checks that trust is_valid allow building/fire-related permits with incomplete filings and no expiry. Illegal or expired-scope work proceeds under a Valid=True stamp.
findings.attack_path:
1. Agent uses check_permit_status as the can-work permit gate.
2. Permit is ACTIVE (legitimately or via prior forge) with submitted_documents missing structural/fire docs and expiry_date=None.
3. missing_documents alert is raised but is_valid stays True.
4. Downstream dig/pour/energize proceeds as permitted.
findings.remediation: Require non-empty future expiry_date and zero missing required documents before is_valid=True. Fail closed on incomplete filings.
findings.poc_video_notes: Local PoC: ACTIVE + missing specs/survey/structural_calcs/fire_protection + expiry=None → is_valid=True.
